content.text: **Summary:** I read ticket T-6007, listed pods in the `marketing` namespace, and immediately spotted that the new `docs-site:4.3.0` pod was in `CrashLoopBackOff` (11 restarts) while the 4.2 pods were healthy. Comparing the security contexts, I noticed `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true` was newly added in 4.3. The pod logs confirmed the crash: Next.js 14 fails at startup trying to `mkdir /app/.next/cache` and gets `EROFS: read-only file system`. The fix is to add an `emptyDir` volume mounted at `/app/.next/cache`, giving Next.js a writable scratch area while preserving the read-only root filesystem security hardening. Ticket resolved.
